title: Concept: Development tooling is treated as a runtime dependency
description: packages.config declares a development-only package declared as a shipped dependency, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a development-only package declared as a shipped dependency.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through packages.config (nuget).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a development-only package declared as a shipped dependency.
